verdict.rationale: Finix documents API surfaces an agent could drive. Seller payouts are manageable via Dashboard or API (finix-docs-12). There is a guide for diagnosing failed payouts (finix-docs-16), and disputes can be monitored and evidence uploaded and submitted via API (finix-docs-17, finix-docs-18). Agent-oriented aids exist: llms.txt (finix-probe-1) and an official MCP server (finix-probe-2). However, that MCP server is documented only for answering questions about the API (finix-docs-21, finix-docs-27), not for operating on live money data, so an agent must call the raw REST API itself. Missing for 10: operational agent tools (MCP or similar) for reading balances, payouts and disputes; an explicit API for reading balances (only top-ups are evidenced); guidance on investigating a seller's missing payout as distinct from a failed payout; any hands-on or independent corroboration.
